scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 66 km this is Furka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Thun and Lauterbrunnen Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 89 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

road-grand-tour-of-switzerland-part-3.story: 484 km from Airolo to Bussigny, about 6 h 57 of riding. It goes by way of Andermatt, Furka, Grimsel and Interlaken. The highest point is about 2,300 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Suyama Sengen-jinja Shrine → Lake Yamanakako
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 25 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

It strings together lakeside roads.
